conceptName: Signal at Blue Hour — Mio's Meteor Watch
title: Signal at Blue Hour

contentRating.tone: Tasteful slow-burn romance with gentle emotional tension and no sexual content.
contentRating.adultCastPolicy: Mio is explicitly 23 years old. The concept contains no minors, school setting, school uniform, or minor-coded framing.

marketableHook: During meteor-watch week, a late-night equipment fault leaves the player alone at a seaside radio observatory with Mio Amamiya, a guarded young researcher whose dry wit brightens as the sky darkens.

heroine.name: Mio Amamiya
heroine.role: Adult graduate astronomy researcher working the observatory night shift.
personality: warmly expressive once trust is earned

identityLock.hair: Dark-indigo shoulder-length bob with a soft inward curl and side-swept fringe.
identityLock.outfit: Professional navy research cardigan over an ivory mock-neck blouse with a slim amber pendant; contemporary adult workplace clothing, not a school uniform.
identityLock.proportions: Clearly adult facial structure and body proportions; tasteful non-sexualized presentation.

setting.location: Seaside radio observatory control terrace during meteor-watch week.
setting.time: Blue hour moving into the first stars.

artDirection.medium: Polished contemporary Japanese visual-novel anime illustration.
artDirection.palette: Blue-hour indigo and teal with restrained amber highlights.
artDirection.finish: Clean expressive linework, soft cel shading, delicate atmospheric gradients, premium dating-sim key-art polish.
constraints: no text, logos, signatures, or watermarks in generated assets
no sexualized pose or camera angle
no school-uniform styling or minor coding

neutral.meaning: Reserved attentiveness and a faint professional half-smile.

delighted.meaning: Genuine open smile, softly lifted brows, and brightened eyes.

flustered.meaning: Subtle warm blush, shy side glance, and a small uncertain smile.

concerned.meaning: Focused serious gaze, gently knit brows, and composed closed lips.

assets.spriteFraming: Matching upper-body crop from the top of the hair through the lower ribcage, centered on a portrait canvas.
